sources._comment: block/stalagnate_bowl_wart references item/nether_wart, which lives on the item atlas. 26.3 rejects a block model that names a sprite the block atlas has no source for, so the model was dropped entirely and the wart-filled bowl rendered as a missing model. Atlas definitions merge across namespaces, so adding the sprite here extends vanilla's blocks.json rather than replacing it, and keeps the original texture.
